dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "anomaly"
$anomaly_detection = strings.concat(security_result.description, ", ", re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""), ", ", security_result.detection_fields["item"])
$anomaly_detection = /$anomaly_detection$/ nocase
observer.hostname =  /$sensor$/ nocase
network.session_id = /$uid$/ nocase
security_result.detection_fields["item_score"] =  /$item_score$/ nocase
security_result.rule_name = %corelight_use_cases.use_case

match:
    $timestamp

    $items_during_baseline_period = array_distinct(additional.fields["entity_training_item_0"])
    $anomalous_entities = array_distinct(re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""))

dashboardQueries.query:
$e1.metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
$e1.metadata.product_event_type = "anomaly"
$anomaly_detection = strings.concat($e1.security_result.description, ", ", re.replace($e1.additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""), ", ", $e1.security_result.detection_fields["item"])
$anomaly_detection = /$anomaly_detection$/ nocase
$e1.network.session_id = /$uid$/ nocase
$e1.observer.hostname =  /$sensor$/ nocase
$e1.security_result.detection_fields["item_score"] =  /$item_score$/ nocase
$e1.security_result.rule_name = %corelight_use_cases.use_case
$e1.network.session_id != ""
not re.regex($e1.security_result.detection_fields["item"], "^client_")
$entity_ip = re.replace($e1.additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", "")

$e2.metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
$e2.metadata.product_event_type = "conn" OR $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "conn_red" OR $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "conn_agg"
$e2.additional.fields["direction"] = "inbound"
$ip = $e2.principal.ip
$entity_ip = $e2.target.ip
match:
    $ip

outcome:
    $first_external_access_time = timestamp.get_timestamp(min($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds), "%B %d, %I:%M:%S %p", "UTC")
    $last_external_access_time = timestamp.get_timestamp(max($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds), "%B %d, %I:%M:%S %p", "UTC")
    $bytes_sent = math.round(sum($e2.network.sent_bytes)/1073741824, 2)
    $bytes_received = math.round(sum($e2.network.received_bytes)/1073741824, 2)
    $bytes_diff = math.round(math.abs(sum($e2.network.received_bytes - $e2.network.sent_bytes)/1073741824), 2)
    $service = array_distinct($e2.network.application_protocol)
    $connections = count($e2.network.session_id)

order:
    $bytes_diff desc

dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "anomaly"
$anomaly_detection = strings.concat(security_result.description, ", ", re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""), ", ", security_result.detection_fields["item"])
$anomaly_detection = /$anomaly_detection$/ nocase

security_result.detection_fields["item_score"] =  /$item_score$/ nocase
security_result.rule_name = %corelight_use_cases.use_case
$tier_type = re.capture(strings.concat(strings.concat("LC#####", re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""), "#####", security_result.detection_fields["item"]), ", ", strings.concat("LC#####", re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""), "#####", strings.concat(additional.fields["nn1_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn2_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn3_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn4_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn5_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn6_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn7_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn8_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn9_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn10_train_item"])), ", ", strings.concat("CR#####", security_result.detection_fields["item"], "#####", security_result.detection_fields["item_assoc_entities_0"])), "^(.*?)#####")
$left_side = re.capture(strings.concat(strings.concat("LC#####", re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""), "#####", security_result.detection_fields["item"]), ", ", strings.concat("LC#####", re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""), "#####", strings.concat(additional.fields["nn1_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn2_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn3_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn4_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn5_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn6_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn7_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn8_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn9_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn10_train_item"])), ", ", strings.concat("CR#####", security_result.detection_fields["item"], "#####", security_result.detection_fields["item_assoc_entities_0"])), "^.*?#####(.*?)#####")
$right_side = re.capture(strings.concat(strings.concat("LC#####", re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""), "#####", security_result.detection_fields["item"]), ", ", strings.concat("LC#####", re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""), "#####", strings.concat(additional.fields["nn1_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn2_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn3_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn4_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn5_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn6_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn7_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn8_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn9_train_item"], ", ",additional.fields["nn10_train_item"])), ", ", strings.concat("CR#####", security_result.detection_fields["item"], "#####", security_result.detection_fields["item_assoc_entities_0"])), ".*#####(.*)$")
network.session_id != ""

outcome:
    $Entities = array_distinct(if($tier_type = "LC", $left_side, ""))
    $Items = array_distinct(if($tier_type = "LC", $right_side, $left_side))
    $Item_Associated_Entities = array_distinct(if($tier_type ="CR", $right_side, ""))
    $count = count(network.session_id)

dashboardQueries.name: 0b1414b3-5cbb-4f73-9476-30400bbcf428
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "notice" OR metadata.product_event_type = "suricata_corelight" OR metadata.product_event_type = "yara" OR metadata.product_event_type = "corelight_ml_results"
observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
principal.ip = /$src_ip$/ nocase
target.ip = /$dest_ip$/ nocase

$signature = strings.coalesce(security_result.rule_name, security_result.summary, additional.fields["fuid"])
$severity = strings.coalesce(security_result.severity_details, security_result.detection_fields["severity_level"], if(security_result.severity="CRITICAL", "Critical",if(security_result.severity="ERROR", "Error", if(security_result.severity="HIGH", "High", if(security_result.severity="INFORMATIONAL", "Informational", if(security_result.severity="LOW", "Low", if(security_result.severity="MEDIUM", "Medium", if(security_result.severity="NONE", "None", "Unknown Severity"))))))), "Unknown Severity")
$uid = metadata.ingestion_labels["uid"]
$detection = strings.concat(strings.coalesce(security_result.rule_name, security_result.summary, additional.fields["fuid"]), " | ", principal.ip)
$event_type = metadata.product_event_type
$src_ip = principal.ip
$dest_ip = target.ip
$src_ip != "" or $dest_ip != ""
match:
    $signature, $src_ip, $dest_ip, $event_type

outcome:
    $connections = count($uid)
    $first_ts = timestamp.get_timestamp(min(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds), "%B %d, %I:%M:%S %p", "UTC")
    $latest_ts = timestamp.get_timestamp(max(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds), "%B %d, %I:%M:%S %p", "UTC")
    $severity_values = array_distinct($severity)
    $corelight_detection = array_distinct($detection)

order:
    $first_ts asc
